summary: The wipe is complete against the verbatim request: every menu, getter, the MENU_TO_KEYWORD dispatch table and _send_interactive_list are gone from the inbound handler, all wd_menu sends are gone from whatsapp-calling, all seven former send sites plus _handle_list_reply and both post-call paths reach the plain-text placeholder, the IVR button menu and both Lambdas are intact and importable, and nothing was deployed ($LATEST and the live-alias version share an identical CodeSha256 on all four functions, last modified before these commits). Commit 5572b213 closes both findings from the previous pass - the three TestNothingWasTakenAway assertions are carried across word for word as TestNothingBecameUnreachable, and tests/test_calling_menu_template_is_gone.py now pins the previously unasserted calling half.
verified_this_pass: PRIOR FINDING 1 RESOLVED. tests/test_menus_are_deleted.py::TestNothingBecameUnreachable restores all three assertions. Diffed against `git show 2c6cfea3:tests/test_one_menu.py` lines 279-307: the assertion bodies are identical word for word (appointment keywords; 'leave review'/'order notes' in flow keywords and 'my id'/'store'/'gift card'/'bharat stack'/'about' in their function-local sets via _nested_literal; the six *mentions* in _send_help_about's source). Only menu-shaped docstring framing changed. The _flow_keywords helper was carried across. Nothing weakened.

PRIOR FINDING 2 RESOLVED. tests/test_calling_menu_template_is_gone.py (170 lines) loads whatsapp-calling by file path under a unique module name with boto3 patched and asserts all five requested properties: (a) 'wd_menu' absent from the source and no _send_ivr_menu attribute; (b) MENU_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT byte-identical across the two Lambdas, loaded and compared; (c) an AST walk of _send_menu_placeholder_text showing _meta_api_call present and _send_via_aws absent, plus exactly one payload dict with type == 'text'; (d) both _handle_post_call_sip and _send_call_whatsapp_notification calling _send_menu_placeholder_text; (e) the eight-symbol keep list present and IVR_RESPONSES holding ivr_callback, ivr_support and ivr_ai.

AST: 0 Assign targets named MENU_TO_KEYWORD and 0 Calls to _send_interactive_list at any depth. _process_ai_automation body is exactly ['Expr','Return'] with all 10 params. grep -c wd_menu on whatsapp-calling is 0; _send_ivr_menu 0 matches.

NO SILENCE AND NO CRASH on every path the brief names. 8 _send_menu_placeholder occurrences = 1 def + 7 calls: followup_explore 1443, request_welcome 1633, BUTTON_MENU_TRIGGERS 1670, HI_KEYWORDS 1933, CUSTOMERSERVICE_KEYWORDS 1977, brand-new-contact 2053 (welcomeSent write kept, so no re-send loop), and _handle_list_reply 6600 which now answers ANY row id - strictly better than the pre-wipe list_reply_unhandled tail that replied nothing. Post-call: _handle_post_call_sip 1110 and _send_call_whatsapp_notification 2541 + 2547 (retry) call _send_menu_placeholder_text. The three trigger sets survive at 1664/1920/1969 with guard expressions byte-identical, evidenced by test_own_prefill_triggers_menu.py::test_menu_sets_use_the_fallback passing unedited.

THE KEEP LIST IS INTACT. Both Lambdas load by file path with boto3.resource and boto3.client patched and raise nothing. _SHARED_IVR_MENU, IVR_MENUS, IVR_DEFAULT_MENU, IVR_RESPONSES, _get_ivr_menu, _react_thumbs_up, _is_auto_thumb_reaction_enabled and _is_postcall_wa_enabled all present; IVR_RESPONSES holds ivr_ai, ivr_callback, ivr_sales, ivr_support. No Lambda deleted. _handle_list_reply keeps all five params.

NO DEPLOY, NO ALIAS MOVE. Measured live via GetFunctionConfiguration + GetAlias: wecare-inbound-whatsapp (live v67), wecare-whatsapp-calling (live v39), wecare-ai-generate-response (live v36), wecare-outbound-whatsapp (live v44) each report an identical CodeSha256 on $LATEST and on the version the live alias points at, LastModified 2026-10-02T02:27-02:29Z, before the earliest of these four commits. The deleted menus therefore remain live on both WABAs until the owner authorises a publish and alias move.

TEST DECISIONS SOUND. tests/test_one_menu.py deleted only after its one non-menu class was carried forward; its test_ai_handler_returns_to_the_one_menu was correctly not carried because its subject (a menu to resolve to) no longer exists. test_own_prefill_triggers_menu.py updated for naming only. test_outbound_whatsapp.py:218 and test_notifications_domain.py:576,616 correctly left alone (transport fixture and a different gated subsystem). The 9 failures (test_blog_ledger, test_checkout_website_handler, test_coupons_iam_and_table x3, test_email_verification_handler, test_gift_cards_iam_and_table x2, test_provision_checkout_contract) are in files this diff does not touch and were reproduced at 2c6cfea3 before the wipe.

COMMITS USED EXPLICIT PATHS AND SWEPT NOTHING IN, despite five concurrent task directories sitting untracked. c3a6b165 = inbound handler + 3 test files; 365bbd18 = calling handler + test_calling.py; ef79ec16 = ai-generate-response + outbound-whatsapp, verified comment-only by reading the full diff (no logic, signature or customer-visible string changed); 5572b213 = 2 test files, additions only. 2c6cfea3..HEAD is 9 files, 609 insertions, 1663 deletions. Working tree now holds only the six untracked .agents task directories.
reported_not_required: The post-call WhatsApp follow-up is now a TEXT send and needs an open 24-hour customer-service window; the deleted template was what allowed a send outside it. A caller who has never messaged the business will not receive it. Deliberate, documented in the helper docstring, logged, non-blocking at both call sites, and the post-call SMS (ivr-default DLT) and Sinch RCS paths still reach the caller.

voice-in/obd/handler.py (832, 928-990, 1018) and voice-in/c2c/handler.py (356, 439-501, 529) still build the deleted wd_menu template on every CDR and write '[wd_menu template] ...' into their tables as though delivered. Outside this task's two-handler scope and already in the FEAT-002 findings; docs/notification-retirement-manifest.md measured 0 firings over 14 days for both.

The dashboard still exposes editable menu config nothing reads: src/pages/workspace/engage/whatsapp/auto-response.tsx, scripts.tsx:62,71 (category 'Menu', trigger 'hi / menu / start') and dashboard/index.tsx:1894,1897. No backend reads welcome_message_config, customerservice_menu_config or bot_language_picker_config after the wipe, so no menu can resurrect, but the Scripts page misreports live behaviour to the owner who is about to design the replacement. TypeScript was outside this task's scope.
WA_TEMPLATE_VIDEO_URL (whatsapp-calling:1498) is now referenced only by its own assignment - inert, already in the FEAT-002 findings.

Log event names call_wa_template_sent / call_wa_template_FAILED are knowingly stale now that they carry text sends. Left alone because docs/notification-retirement-manifest.md:22 keys its Phase 9 rows on those identifiers and docs/ was outside the owned paths; the now-false 'template': 'wd_menu' field inside each payload was changed to 'messageType': 'text'. Rename both together later.

_send_menu_placeholder_text swallows the Meta response, so the failure event no longer carries errorCode/errorMessage/httpStatus/fullError. The cause is still logged one level down by _meta_api_call, so it is decorrelated from the requestId-bearing event rather than lost - which matters more now that the expected failure is a closed 24-hour window (Meta 131047).

PRE-EXISTING AND UNCHANGED BY THIS DIFF: a button_reply id that is neither ivr_*, followup_explore nor followup_done falls out of the interactive block and, because msg_type is 'interactive' rather than 'text', skips the keyword branch and gets no reply. Verified byte-identical against 2c6cfea3 - the button_reply branch never consulted MENU_TO_KEYWORD, so no button id became dead as a result of the wipe. Separately, _load_fallback_message has no caller in either tree, so DEFAULT_FALLBACK_MESSAGE is never sent; it was correctly left alone after a filtered Scan of stack-wecare-digital-SystemConfigTable for id='wa_auto_response' returned Count=0.

whatsapp-business-api/handler.py:2527 keeps a generic _send_interactive_list behind the /interactive-list admin route. It composes sections entirely from the request body and holds no stored menu, so it is a send primitive rather than a menu - and it is what a replacement menu will need.
Nothing is live. Both functions sit behind a live alias, so the menus remain live on both WABAs until the owner authorises a publish and alias move.
